title: Saigon music: Thu 26 & Fri 27 Nov
sub: Club nights, DJs and disco in Ho Chi Minh City tonight and tomorrow, from RA and listings sites
tip: Thursday is quiet: Luu Bar's weekly Luu Session is the one solid pick. Friday has more going on. Also on Friday: Mindaniel's Open Mind at Halo Saigon Skybar (on RA, line-up TBA). I couldn't find its address, so it has no pin. Pins are approximate, so tap the Google Maps button, which searches the exact address. Check the venue's Instagram before you go, because Saigon line-ups change late.

places.name: Luu Bar
notes: THU 26: Luu Session, the weekly Thursday night of upbeat house, disco and indie dance, with happy hour deals
FRI 27: Best Of Open CUE by Dopeamin
Late-night cocktail bar and underground music spot, ~10 min Grab from Wink
